# <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="../icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> Substrate Weight

<p class="hdue-node-type">VOP node · <code>hdue::substrate_weight::1.3</code></p>

Scales a surface's coverage.
{ .hdue-node-summary }

It is part of an hdUE Substrate Material Builder graph, which hdUE prepares into a UE Substrate material; it does not run as a VEX or MaterialX shader.

## Inputs

Surface
:   Surface to weight.

Weight
:   Coverage, from 0 (removed) to 1 (whole).

## Parameters

Weight
:   Coverage, from 0 (removed) to 1 (whole).

    `weight` · Default 1
